annotations.title: Sanctions, Watchlist & Embargo Entity Screener API

description: Sanctions, Watchlist & Embargo Entity Screener API: Screen beneficiaries, vendors, BICs, and wallets against embargo rules and fuzzy sanctions watchlists. (Endpoint: POST /v1/sanctions-screener)

country_code.description: Optional 2-letter ISO country code to evaluate jurisdiction embargo and FATF risk.

custom_watchlist.description: Optional caller-provided watchlist entries to fuzzy-screen alongside built-in EU/OFAC/UN/UK designations.

entity_name.description: Company, organization, vessel, or individual name to screen.

identifiers.description: Optional structured financial or corporate identifiers for exact watchlist matching.

similarity_threshold.description: Minimum normalized Jaro-Winkler / phonetic similarity score (0.50..1.00) to report a name match.

name: tinplate_sanctions_screener
